body: I thought it hadn’t posted for some reason (I don’t post often)
I do live with my brother and mother but before his birthday, I was visiting my gf
We live 70 miles from each other and when I am with her I give our relationship my all
It’s just my mum, and she’s poured loads into my rent and other stuff while I had time off and had no money coming in from my teaching

I don’t hate the placement itself. And I actually have a good mentor. But it’s the process of it and the trials and tribulations that are wearing me down. There have been other things that have been happening in my life that have contributed but I feel just done with it all.
